title: Kagamine Rin — Coloring SEKAI〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: The Way I Played That Day

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI
Lake
se_walk_women_001_1
se_walk_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, Ena, you came.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: With Mizuki. I didn't know you'd both be coming.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I decided to help out since I just happened to have some free time on my hands.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I thought you were here to poke fun at our mistakes?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha! I'd say about half and half!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyway, I heard that Rin was doing a drawing of the lake. Are you guys also working on something, Miku, Len?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We've just been coloring in the drawings Rin's been making...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You drew a lot in the end, right?
How many in total?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Four...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wow, that is a lot.
I just handed you that sketchbook the other day too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Based on Ena's reaction, you must've been working really hard, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Not really...
It's not like I had anything else to do.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah, but Rin...
Are you sure about us having these sketches?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah... I've kept my practice ones separate from the ones I'm really working on. It just seemed like a shame to toss them...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I see...
Then, we'll do our best to color them in.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: By the way, I have a suggestion. Wanna hear it?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: A suggestion?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. This place is basically all gray, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's hard to make the colors distinguishable when you have barely any to work with. So I say anyone who wants to, should be free to do whatever.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So... We can color the sky blue and stuff?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'd like to try drawing some flowers...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Would you mind if we did, Rin...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Go for it.
Show me when you're done...

rows.Speaker: Len & Miku
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'll color things as they are, Ena...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay. I'll teach you what I can.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Then, Ena, you help Rin.
I'll lend Miku and Len a hand.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You'd do that? Alright, I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Okay!
Let's start coloring!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Mizuki, how does this shade of blue look to you for the sky...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, that looks good!
It feels like a nice, warm sky in the spring.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you for letting me borrow your phone, Mizuki. I'll try drawing this flower...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, lemme see.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Color where there's light hitting the object, but leave places where light's reflecting off blank... It's perfectly okay to leave certain spots white.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Where the light hits...
Which spots are those exactly?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: For example, with the beams sticking out of the ground...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Alright, we'll go on three.
One, two, three!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, Miku, you have a flower floating in your lake...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Your sky is blue and has clouds in it, Len.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Your drawing's amazing, Rin...
The beams and lake are all the right colors...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
She's right...
It's like a photo.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You're exaggerating.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
This beam's bent.
The things that are up close and far away still look funny...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Still, aren't you glad that you managed to finish it?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That's what impresses me the most.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ena...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That was fun...
Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You're welcome.
